''See also: [[Tyria Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyria is a [[Champion]] characterized by an unconventional personality, as she lacks the typical drive for combat and shows minimal devotion to [[The Empire|the Empire]]. While she was previously known for remaining within her quarters in the [[Imperial]] Palace, she is highly effective at apprehending targets. In combat, she utilizes [[Soulbound powers]] that manifest as golden light and thorny vines to ensnare enemies. Her preferred armament is a large, silver [[needle]]-like weapon. Despite her casual demeanor and relaxed habits, she is a formidable combatant capable of significant [[destruction]] when utilizing her abilities.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyria is a [[Champion]] who dresses in mail and leather armor. She carries a silver [[needle]] as her weapon of choice.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyria directed her silver [[needle]] at [[Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster]]. She used her [[Soulbound powers]] to cast golden ropes toward [[Shera]], and she believes that [[Calder]] is dead. Additionally, Tyria is a person to whom researchers would report [[Petal]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyria utilizes [[Soulbound powers]] that manifest as golden vines of light and pooling gold around her feet. She can cast thorny ropes of shining gold or use golden thorns to capture her enemies.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Of Kings and Killers}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a [[Champion]], Tyria wears armor composed of mail and leather.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref> She utilizes a silver [[needle]] as a weapon and possesses [[Soulbound]] power designed for capturing enemies, which manifests as golden vines of light and gold pooling at her feet.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" /> During an encounter with [[Shera]], Tyria cast thorny ropes of shining gold using her [[Soulbound]] abilities after stumbling out of the fog onto the Steward's body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" /> While carrying a red-haired person in white armor who has a wound on his back, Tyria believes that [[Calder]] is dead.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> She is an individual the researchers would report to [[Petal]], and she once leveled her silver [[needle]] at [[Dalton Foster|Foster]]'s chest.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}
